workflow_definition.prompt: Identify all critical bugs in the codebase. List them in state/bug_reports.txt with details such as file paths, line numbers, and descriptions.
Apply code changes to fix identified bugs. Ensure no destructive edits are made.
Create unit tests for each bug fix to ensure they pass. Save new tests in the tests/ directory.
Create integration tests to validate the bug fixes in different parts of the system. Save new tests in the tests/ directory.
Document the bug fixing process and any new changes or fixes in docs/bug_fixing_report.md.
